as_told.title: Il Duce's telegram banning mention of an unknown aircraft landing

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, points to a book by an Italian researcher, Roberto Pinotti, about telegrams said to come from Italy's Fascist government in 1933. Pinotti quotes one as saying that, by personal order of Mussolini, Italy's dictator, nothing at all may be said about the reported landing of an unknown aircraft on Italian soil, and he links the telegrams to the Stefani agency, the country's news agency of that era. If true, it would mean a government was hiding a strange landing well before UFOs became a public topic.
